narrative:
Richland County has 77,661 registered voters, with 54.1% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 30.6% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 15.3%, a pronounced Republican lean of 15.3 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.0% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -8.2% D−R vs -19.3% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
